findings.claim: The reference compose profile injects an empty `CDC_TENANT_ID` environment variable when CDC is disabled, which can make gateway configuration parsing fail before the new disabled-CDC validation path is reached.
findings.evidence: The compose hunk changes `CDC_TENANT_ID` to `"${FRF_CDC_TENANT_ID:-}"`, while `GatewayConfig` declares `cdc_tenant_id: Option<Uuid>` and `from_env` assigns `cdc_tenant_id` unconditionally before validation; the acceptance receipt states the profile should accept empty CDC-specific inputs while disabled.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not set `CDC_TENANT_ID` at all when disabled, or normalize empty CDC env values to `None` before UUID parsing in `GatewayConfig::from_env`.
